title: Fix ImportError: 'Retry' not found in 'ledger_core.vendor.http_util'
body: This PR addresses an ImportError caused by the missing 'Retry' name in the 'ledger_core.vendor.http_util' module. The test failure was diagnosed as a dependency issue, where the module exports 'RetryPolicy' instead of 'Retry'. The fix updates the import in 'ledger_core/http_client.py' to use 'RetryPolicy' instead, aligning the code with the actual exported name. The change was verified to be safe and correct, with all tests and lint checks passing in the sandbox. This resolves the consistent test failure across 3 reruns without introducing new issues.
